        msection_cable2 = fea.ChBeamSectionCable()
        msection_cable2.SetDiameter(0.015)  # Set the diameter of the cable section to 15 mm

        # Create a ChBuilderCableANCF helper object to facilitate the creation of ANCF beams
        builder = fea.ChBuilderCableANCF()
        # Use BuildBeam to create a beam structure consisting of ANCF elements:
        builder.BuildBeam(
            mesh,  # The mesh to which the created nodes and elements will be added
            msection_cable2,  # The beam section properties to use
            10,  # Number of ANCF elements to create along the beam
            chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.1),  # Starting point ('A' point) of the beam
            chrono.ChVector3d(0.5, 0, -0.1)  # Ending point ('B' point) of the beam

        constraint_hinge.Initialize(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back(), mtruss)

import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.fea as fea
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model1: Multiple chains of beams composed of ANCF cable elements,
# each chain connected to a fixed truss and a box body at the end.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Model1:
    def __init__(self, system, mesh, n_chains=6):
        self.system = system
        self.mesh = mesh
        self.n_chains = n_chains

        # Store references to end bodies (boxes) of each chain for printing positions
        self.end_bodies = []

        # Parameters for beam geometry and positioning
        base_start_x = 0.0
        base_start_y = 0.0
        base_start_z = -0.1
        beam_length = 0.5
        beam_spacing_y = 0.1  # vertical spacing between chains to avoid overlap

        for i in range(self.n_chains):
            # Create a section for the cable beam
            msection_cable = fea.ChBeamSectionCable()
            msection_cable.SetDiameter(0.015)  # 15 mm diameter
            msection_cable.SetYoungModulus(0.01e9)  # 0.01 GPa
            msection_cable.SetRayleighDamping(0.0001)

            # Create a builder for ANCF cable beams
            builder = fea.ChBuilderCableANCF()

            # Number of elements increases with each chain (starting from 10)
            n_elements = 10 + i

            # Calculate start and end points for this chain to avoid overlap
            start_point = chrono.ChVector3d(base_start_x,
                                           base_start_y + i * beam_spacing_y,
                                           base_start_z)
            end_point = chrono.ChVector3d(base_start_x + beam_length,
                                         base_start_y + i * beam_spacing_y,
                                         base_start_z)

            # Build the beam mesh for this chain
            builder.BuildBeam(
                self.mesh,
                msection_cable,
                n_elements,
                start_point,
                end_point
            )

            # Apply force to the front node (start node)
            front_node = builder.GetLastBeamNodes().front()
            front_node.SetForce(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -0.7, 0))

            # Create a fixed truss body as reference frame for this chain
            mtruss = chrono.ChBody()
            mtruss.SetBodyFixed(True)
            self.system.Add(mtruss)

            # Hinge constraint to fix beam's start node to the truss
            constraint_hinge = fea.ChLinkNodeFrame()
            constraint_hinge.Initialize(front_node, mtruss)
            self.system.Add(constraint_hinge)

            # Create a box body at the beam's end point
            mbox = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1000, True, True)
            # Position the box at the beam's end point
            end_node = builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back()
            # The node's position is in absolute coordinates
            mbox.SetPos(end_node.GetPos())
            mbox.SetBodyFixed(False)
            self.system.Add(mbox)

            # Connect the beam's end node to the box with a constraint
            constraint_end = fea.ChLinkNodeXYZ()
            constraint_end.Initialize(end_node, mbox)
            self.system.Add(constraint_end)

            # Store the box body for position printing
            self.end_bodies.append(mbox)

    def PrintBodyPositions(self):
        print("Positions of end bodies:")
        for i, body in enumerate(self.end_bodies):
            pos = body.GetPos()
            print(f" Chain {i}: Position = ({pos.x:.4f}, {pos.y:.4f}, {pos.z:.4f})")


# Initialize the physical system and mesh container:
sys = chrono.ChSystemSMC()
mesh = fea.ChMesh()

# Create the model with multiple chains and add the mesh to the system
model = Model1(sys, mesh, n_chains=6)
sys.Add(mesh)  # Add the mesh to the physical system

# Add visualization for the FEM mesh:
visualizebeamA = chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA(mesh)
visualizebeamA.SetFEMdataType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.DataType_ELEM_BEAM_MZ)  # Display moments along the beam
visualizebeamA.SetColorscaleMinMax(-0.4, 0.4)  # Set color scale for moment visualization
visualizebeamA.SetSmoothFaces(True)  # Enable smooth faces for better visualization
visualizebeamA.SetWireframe(False)  # Set to non-wireframe mode
mesh.AddVisualShapeFEA(visualizebeamA)  # Add the visualization shape to the mesh

# Add visualization for node positions:
visualizebeamB = chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA(mesh)
visualizebeamB.SetFEMglyphType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.GlyphType_NODE_DOT_POS)  # Display nodes as dots
visualizebeamB.SetFEMdataType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.DataType_NONE)  # No additional FEM data visualization
visualizebeamB.SetSymbolsThickness(0.006)  # Set thickness of symbols
visualizebeamB.SetSymbolsScale(0.01)  # Set scale of symbols
visualizebeamB.SetZbufferHide(False)  # Ensure symbols are not hidden by z-buffer
mesh.AddVisualShapeFEA(visualizebeamB)  # Add the node visualization to the mesh

# Create the Irrlicht visualization for rendering
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(sys)  # Attach Irrlicht to the Chrono system
vis.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)  # Set the size of the rendering window
vis.SetWindowTitle('FEA cables - Multiple Chains')  # Set the title of the rendering window
vis.Initialize()  # Initialize the visualization
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))  # Add a logo to the window
vis.AddSkyBox()  # Add a skybox for better aesthetics
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0.6, -1))  # Add a camera with specific position
vis.AddTypicalLights()  # Add typical lights for better illumination

# Set solver type and settings
solver = chrono.ChSolverMINRES()  # MINRES solver
if solver.GetType() == chrono.ChSolver.Type_MINRES:
    print("Using MINRES solver")
    sys.SetSolver(solver)
    solver.SetMaxIterations(200)
    solver.SetTolerance(1e-10)
    solver.EnableDiagonalPreconditioner(True)
    solver.EnableWarmStart(True)  # IMPORTANT for convergence when using EULER_IMPLICIT_LINEARIZED
    solver.SetVerbose(False)

# Set the timestepper for the simulation
ts = chrono.ChTimestepperEulerImplicitLinearized(sys)
sys.SetTimestepper(ts)

# Simulation loop
time_step = 0.01
while vis.Run():
    vis.BeginScene()  # Begin scene rendering
    vis.Render()  # Render the scene
    vis.EndScene()  # End scene rendering

    sys.DoStepDynamics(time_step)  # Advance the simulation by one step

    # Print positions of end bodies at each step
    model.PrintBodyPositions()

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.fea as fea
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# 1. Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())  # Ensure data path is set (optional if environment variable set)

system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))  # Gravity pointing downwards

# 2. Add the required physical systems and objects as specified

# Create the mesh container for ANCF cable elements
mesh = fea.ChMesh()

# Beam parameters
beam_length = 2.0  # meters
beam_radius = 0.02  # meters (for visualization)
num_elements = 10

# Material properties for the beam (steel-like)
density = 7850  # kg/m^3
E = 2.1e11  # Young's modulus in Pa
nu = 0.3  # Poisson ratio
G = E / (2 * (1 + nu))  # Shear modulus

# Cross-section properties (circular cross-section)
area = chrono.CH_C_PI * beam_radius**2
I = (chrono.CH_C_PI * beam_radius**4) / 4  # second moment of area

# Create the ANCF cable section
section = fea.ChBeamSectionCable()
section.SetDensity(density)
section.SetYoungModulus(E)
section.SetGshear(G)
section.SetCrossSectionCircular(beam_radius)

# Create nodes and elements
nodes = []
for i in range(num_elements + 1):
    x = beam_length * i / num_elements
    # Initial position of node
    pos = chrono.ChVectorD(x, 0, 0)
    # Initial slope vector (tangent) along x-axis
    slope = chrono.ChVectorD(1, 0, 0)
    node = fea.ChNodeFEAxyzD(pos, slope)
    mesh.AddNode(node)
    nodes.append(node)

# Create ANCF cable elements connecting nodes
for i in range(num_elements):
    element = fea.ChElementCableANCF()
    element.SetNodes(nodes[i], nodes[i + 1])
    element.SetSection(section)
    element.SetAlphaDamp(0.01)  # Some damping
    mesh.AddElement(element)

# Add the mesh to the system
system.Add(mesh)

# 2b. Add a fixed hinge at the first node (beam root)
# We fix the first node's position and slope to simulate a hinged support.
# For a hinge, we fix position but allow rotation. However, ANCF nodes have position and slope degrees of freedom.
# To simulate a hinge, we fix the position but leave slope free.
# PyChrono does not have direct hinge constraints on ANCF nodes, so we fix the node's position DOFs only.

# Fix the first node's position (x,y,z) but leave slope free
nodes[0].SetFixed(True)  # This fixes all DOFs (position + slope)
# To simulate a hinge (fixed position but free slope), we need to fix only position DOFs.
# PyChrono does not provide direct partial fixing on ANCF nodes,
# so we use a workaround: create a constraint that fixes position but not slope.

# Remove full fix and instead create a constraint to fix position only:
nodes[0].SetFixed(False)

# Create a constraint to fix the first node's position to its initial position
pos_constraint = chrono.ChLinkLockPoint()
pos_constraint.Initialize(nodes[0], None, nodes[0].GetPos())
system.AddLink(pos_constraint)

# 3. Visualization setup with Irrlicht
application = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(system, "ANCF Cable Beam Simulation", chronoirr.dimension2du(1024, 768))

application.AddTypicalSky()
application.AddTypicalLights()
application.AddTypicalCamera(chronoirr.vector3df(beam_length * 0.5, beam_length * 0.5, beam_length * 2))

# Visualization of the mesh (beam)
visualize_mesh = fea.ChVisualizationFEAmesh(mesh)
visualize_mesh.SetWireframe(True)
visualize_mesh.SetFEMdataType(fea.ChVisualizationFEAmesh.E_PLOT_NODE_SPEED)  # Color by nodal speed
visualize_mesh.SetColorscaleMinMax(-1, 1)
visualize_mesh.SetShrinkElements(True, 0.85)
mesh.AddVisualization(visualize_mesh)

# Visualization of nodes as spheres
for node in nodes:
    sphere = chrono.ChSphereShape()
    sphere.GetSphereGeometry().rad = beam_radius * 1.5
    node.AddVisualShape(sphere)

application.AssetBindAll()
application.AssetUpdateAll()

# Simulation loop parameters
application.SetTimestep(1e-3)
application.SetTryRealtime(True)

# Run the simulation loop
while application.GetDevice().run():
    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()

    # Optional: print nodal positions (for debugging or monitoring)
    # for i, node in enumerate(nodes):
    #     pos = node.GetPos()
    #     print(f"Node {i}: {pos.x:.3f}, {pos.y:.3f}, {pos.z:.3f}")

    application.DoStep()
    application.EndScene()
